Machop

Fighting

Kanto · Generation 1

Machop is a Fighting-type Superpower Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 0.8 m tall and weighs 19.5 kg. It evolves into Machoke. Its highest base stat is Attack (80), with a base stat total of 305.
